summary: Hand-authored 'report' command exports design/stance-analyzed works as a two-sheet Excel workbook (Works + Summary) via excelize; a regen must keep it distinct from the generated raw-dump 'export' command.
reason: Researchers hand results to spreadsheet-based screening workflows; the generated 'export' command only dumps raw API JSON/JSONL, so analyzed spreadsheet output needs its own command and the github.com/xuri/excelize/v2 dependency in go.mod.
validated_outcome: Export produces a valid two-sheet Excel file with bold headers and correct row counts (verified by reopening with excelize in tests); empty result sets still write a valid workbook; bad extension/missing --output/non-positive --limit exit with usage code 2.
